item.title: NEW: 🟠 An AI security scanner finds a Bitcoin Core bug that lets one crafted me…
item.description: NEW: 🟠 An AI security scanner finds a Bitcoin Core bug that lets one crafted message freeze a node for more than 12 seconds. Project Loupe, built by Elias Rohrer at Block's Spiral, shows that duplicate orphan announcements force a node to repeat the same expensive check thousands of times. The fix ships in Bitcoin Core 30.5, 31.3 and 32.1. The 29.x branch gets no patch, so anyone still running it needs to upgrade. Source: https://x.com/BitcoinNewsCom/status/2124933365497241749

item.description: SECURITY: ⚠️ AI just caught a bug in Bitcoin Core that could have frozen Bitcoin nodes, and it's already fixed. An attacker could have stalled nodes by repeating one transaction ID 50,000 times, delaying blocks and deposits. Jack Dorsey's Block found it with an AI scanner, and Bitcoin Core developers patched it before anyone could exploit it. Source: https://x.com/CryptosR_Us/status/2124461657313153323
